name: zk-waldo
description: A real-image, trained-CNN Where's Waldo proof using RISC Zero.

scripts.zkvm:prove: RISC0_PROVER=ipc cargo run -p zk-waldo-zkvm-host -- prove-tiny --receipt proofs/end_to_end_tiny.risc0.json
scripts.zkvm:prove:full: RISC0_PROVER=ipc cargo run -p zk-waldo-zkvm-host -- prove --commitment demo/commitment.json --witness demo/witness.private.json --receipt proofs/end_to_end_valid.risc0.json
scripts.zkvm:verify:full: cargo run -p zk-waldo-zkvm-host -- verify --commitment demo/commitment.json --receipt proofs/end_to_end_valid.risc0.json
scripts.zkvm:demo: pnpm demo && pnpm zkvm:prove && pnpm zkvm:verify
scripts.real:prove: RISC0_PROVER=ipc cargo run -p zk-waldo-zkvm-host -- prove-real --commitment demo/real/puzzles/ski-slope/commitment.json --witness demo/real/puzzles/ski-slope/witness.private.json --receipt proofs/end_to_end_real.risc0.json
scripts.real:demo: pnpm real:prepare && pnpm real:prove && pnpm real:verify
